name: evaluation/hard-dataset
description: Multi-part, comparative and cross-section questions against the evaluation handbook; the router should pick the hard route

input.query: My purifier's LED is blinking red and my tap water is 45 degrees Celsius. What should I do and is it safe to keep using it?

items.expected_output: Replace the cartridge and reset the counter; 45 degrees exceeds the 40 degree limit so do not operate it.

input.query: Compare what maintenance must be done every month, every 3 months and every 6 months.

items.expected_output: Monthly cleaning, descaling every 3 months, cartridge every 6 months.

input.query: If I use a cheaper third-party cartridge, what happens to my warranty and does the handbook consider it safe?

items.expected_output: The warranty is void; only genuine F-200 cartridges may be used.

input.query: The unit is leaking at the inlet and also makes an unusual noise. What could be wrong with each and how do I fix each problem?

items.expected_output: Tighten the fitting a quarter turn; flush for 2 minutes to remove air.

input.query: How much water must I flush through at installation, how long does that take, and how much water can a cartridge filter before it needs replacing?
Compare the X200 with the X300 model in terms of flow rate and tell me which one is better for a large family.

items.expected_output: The handbook does not describe an X300.
